
For **`data/external/README.md`**:

```markdown
# External Data

This directory is reserved for external supplementary datasets that may be incorporated into future MEDISCOPE research or validation work.

No external dataset is currently required by the final modelling pipeline.

Any future data placed here should be reviewed for:

- licensing;
- redistribution permission;
- privacy;
- provenance;
- versioning;
- reproducibility.

External source files should normally remain excluded from Git unless their licence explicitly permits redistribution.
